name: Bay maintenance bypass interface
summary: Identifies the documented alternate connection associated with maintaining the assigned bay equipment.
description: Identifies the documented alternate connection associated with maintaining the assigned bay equipment. A bay circuit arrangement groups the switching, measuring and protection interfaces associated with a specific network circuit. A line bay, transformer bay and reactor bay share some devices but connect different kinds of primary equipment.

In a switchyard single-line drawing, the bay arrangement helps the reader follow the circuit from its bus connection to the external line, transformer or compensation equipment and identify the measurement boundaries along the path. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Bay main and bypass paths” at the input and “Maintenance bypass connection” at the output. Protection remains a separately validated dependency.
